title: Pipeline Checkpoint
description: Full resumable snapshot after each pipeline stage.

stage.description: Stage name — validated at runtime against the pipeline manifest's stage list

pipeline_type.description: Pipeline manifest name; initialized project identity is immutable and checked at runtime. 'unknown' is legacy-only, never an explicit write override.

artifacts.description: Map of declared output name to artifact data. Registered artifacts must be inline schema-valid objects. Completed compose requires an output-bound passing final_review.

review.description: Reviewer output for this stage, if any
